description: A PNG of the device screen as shown now, scaled to at most 720 px on its short edge, plus its size. tap and swipe take coordinates in this image's pixels (they are mapped to the device). Also numbers of the full-size capture, to tell across runs whether something rendered without looking: meanLuminance (0 black to 1 white), nonBlackRatio (share of pixels with a channel above 24/255, so video black counts as black but dark blue does not), dominantRatio (share of the most common colour) and blank (dominantRatio ≥ 0.98: one colour, black or not, with at most about 2% else, such as status bar icons, a spinner or a small clock; a sparse white page can count too, so check nonBlackRatio for black). Secure windows (FLAG_SECURE, DRM-protected video) are captured black even while they show something. Device control: only available when enabled.

serial.description: adb serial; default: the session device, or the only ready one.
